description: This is a React component source file written in TypeScript and JSX, defining the main application component for a persona builder interface. It manages state for file uploads, process orchestration, persona data editing, and UI rendering for multiple steps including uploading documents, processing status, and persona editing.

methods.description: Safely stringifies a value into JSON, with error handling.

methods.description: Retrieves a readable error message from an unknown error object.

methods.description: Attempts to extract a draft persona object from a generic orchestration record.
